content: While a Time Base Timeout is present ( TIMEOUT bit is set in Time Base synchronization status timeBaseStatus ), FrTSyn shall discard SYNC (or OFS) messages until it has successfully validated (refer to [SWS_FrTSyn_00048]) 'n' consecutive SYNC (or OFS) messages ('n' is given by the parameter FrTSynGlob- alTimeSequenceCounterHysteresis ).
